name: Sacred Earth - Reverie
source:
Sacred Earth - Reverie is a fantasy RPG with visual novel elements, inspired by both classic and modern JRPGs. Explore dungeons, interact with your allies and the townsfolk, build your characters with equipment, abilities, and perks, and test your might against foes in thrilling turn-based combat.

Taking place on Miltiades, a world that has undergone a great regression from a once golden age, humanity now fights a war against an entity known as the 'Demon Queen'. After the latest failed campaign against this great foe, a knight of the Kingdom of Amarcia begins to question the state of their world and the truths of the era. In order to ascertain whether or not things really are as they seem, they depart from their post and set out on a personal journey for answers.
translation:
Sacred Earth - Reverie是一款带有视觉小说元素的奇幻角色扮演游戏，其灵感来自经典和现代日式角色扮演游戏。探索地下城，与你的盟友和城镇居民互动，用装备、能力和特权打造你的角色，并在激动人心的回合制战斗中测试你对抗敌人的力量。

故事发生在米尔蒂亚德，一个从曾经的黄金时代经历了巨大倒退的世界，人类现在正在与一个被称为“恶魔女王”的实体进行战争。在最近一次针对这个伟大敌人的失败战役之后，阿玛西亚王国的一名骑士开始质疑他们的世界状况和时代的真相。为了查明事情是否真的如表面所见，他们离开岗位，踏上个人寻找答案的旅程。
